note: Flagged for Review. These items do not block the merge. They are published on the Flagged for Review page for your review.

flags.title: Short-link codes are not 10-character ASINs
flags.detail: All five codes after link.amazon/ are 9 characters. Each short link resolved to an Amazon product whose /dp/ ASIN is 10 characters and differs from the code. The intended ASIN therefore cannot be read from the supplied links, so the intended ASIN field is blank.
flags.owner_action: Confirm the intended ASIN for each product (or confirm the observed ones are correct).

flags.title: Observed redirect targets do not show the Associates tag
flags.detail: None of the five resolved Amazon URLs contains tag=shopnow047c-20. Program Policies §2(b) says a Special Link must include the Associates ID as a URL parameter. The short link may still attribute clicks by another mechanism, which is not verified here.
flags.owner_action: Run one test click per product through the Associates workflow and check the tracking report (see D1).

flags.title: Compliance status of the supplied short links is unresolved
flags.detail: Program Policies §6(w) prohibits link-shortening used in a way that makes it unclear that a link goes to an Amazon Site. This check was not completed. The brief's FLG-003 and S02 cover the same question. No claim is made that the links are invalid.
flags.owner_action: Decide whether to keep, replace or validate the short links (D1).

flags.title: Associates enrollment and the tracking ID could not be verified
flags.detail: The sandbox has no Associates account login. Nothing confirms that shopnow047c-20 is an active Associates ID, which account it sits under, or that a test click reaches the tracking report. Policy §2(b) describes the ID format as XXXXX-## or 'such other format as we may designate', so the format is not treated as invalid.
flags.owner_action: Confirm the tracking ID and run the Associates test (Questions Q2, Q3).

flags.title: Prices and ratings are not published
flags.detail: Program Policies §2(b) and §6(t) restrict displaying prices and ratings unless Amazon serves them or they come through PA-API / Creators API. The price and rating fields are blank for all five products. They are not inferred.
flags.owner_action: Decide on API enrollment or a link-only approach (D2).

flags.title: Brief asks for price analysis, which §6(y) restricts
flags.detail: The brief asks the platform to analyze pricing over time. Program Policies §6(y) says the site must not have price tracking or price alerting functionality unless Amazon agrees. This conflicts with the brief and cannot be built as described without Amazon's agreement.
flags.owner_action: Decide whether to seek Amazon's agreement or drop price tracking (D2).

flags.title: Brief references IDs and documents that are not in the repository
flags.detail: The brief cites FLG-003, S01, S02, S07, S24, SG-27 to SG-30, Priority 4 and Priority 5, and an 'Operating Agreement' with a 'Schedule 1'. None of these is in the repository. Their content was not reproduced. Where a public Amazon document was found that matches the topic, it is cited instead.
flags.owner_action: Provide the source register or confirm that the public documents above are the intended ones.

flags.title: The five 'defined events' are not defined in the repository
flags.detail: The brief asks for five click and conversion events to be recorded, but the events are not listed anywhere in the repo. No events were invented.

flags.title: Analytics, click counter, and Search Console not implemented
flags.detail: GitHub Pages is static hosting, so a self-hosted click endpoint cannot run on it. Search Console needs a Google account owned by you. No tracking script was added, to avoid collecting data without a decision on privacy and hosting.

flags.title: New-account enrollment threshold not confirmed from a primary source
flags.detail: Secondary guides say an account must make 3 qualifying sales in 180 days to complete enrollment. That claim was not confirmed in Amazon's own text during this session, so it is not stated as fact on the site.
flags.owner_action: Check the current enrollment rule in your Associates account (Q11).

flags.title: Editorial titles are working hypotheses, not findings
flags.detail: The four titles in the brief are working titles. They make no claims about product popularity, search volume or superiority. None is published as a guide.

flags.title: No author, brand, or contact identity was supplied
flags.detail: The publication-style author byline and brand identity cannot be invented. The site uses the placeholder 'Editorial team' and the working name 'Kitchen Picks'.
flags.owner_action: Provide an author name and brand (Q7, Q9).

flags.title: Branch model differs from the brief
flags.detail: The brief asks for one branch per session. Arena fixes each session to one branch, so all work sits on arena/7feafaa3-winb. No other branch was created or pushed to.
flags.owner_action: None needed unless you want per-task branches.

flags.title: No product images used
flags.detail: Amazon product images were not copied. Program Policies §6(a) restricts changes to Program Content, and images for the site should come from Amazon's official linking tools.

flags.title: Product breadcrumbs are observed, not an official taxonomy
flags.detail: Categories (Air fryers, Thermometers) come from the Amazon breadcrumb shown on each product page. They are the observed Amazon taxonomy, not a category list supplied by you.

flags.title: Amazon ASIN help page could not be retrieved
flags.detail: The Amazon ASIN definition page could not be opened in this session, so the ASIN definition is not cited. The ASIN format used here (10 characters) is checked against the /dp/ URLs on Amazon's own product pages.
flags.owner_action: Confirm the ASIN definition from Amazon's help pages.

flags.title: Google's rel="sponsored" guidance is not a ranking promise
flags.detail: Google's page says rel="sponsored" marks paid links and that such links 'will generally not be followed'. It makes no ranking promise, so the site does not claim any SEO benefit from it.

flags.title: 16 CFR 255.5 cited by section title only
flags.detail: Only the table of contents of 16 CFR Part 255 was read. The text of §255.5 was not read in full, so the site makes no claim about its detail. Legal wording was not reviewed by counsel.
flags.owner_action: Have counsel review the disclosure wording before scaling (Q15).
